pairs.description: Hawthorn possesses inotropic properties and may potentiate the pharmacological activity and toxicity risk of digoxin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of myocardial Na+/K+-ATPase and additive positive inotropic activity by oligomeric procyanidins.

pairs.description: Hawthorn extract can produce additive hypotensive and negative chronotropic effects when combined with beta-blockers like metoprolol.
pairs.mechanism: Additive peripheral vasodilatory and cardiac chronotropic suppression mediated by flavonoid constituents.

pairs.description: Combining hawthorn with PDE5 inhibitors can precipitate excessive vasodilation and symptomatic systemic hypotension.
pairs.mechanism: Synergistic vascular smooth muscle relaxation through nitric oxide-cGMP pathway augmentation.
